items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: But the fellow with the last fellow, our president, he just did so wrong and we had to do it with him. His name was David Glenn.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Every year. Every year president.

Every year. Every year. Every year. and we have our relation of officer in March and we installed them in April. We're Sunday in March is our relation of officer and we have installed in May. Of course, I've been vice president for about 10 years. Yeah, well, I could have taken over a long time, but I just didn't want the responsibility. But the fellow with the last fellow, our president, he just did so wrong and we had to do it with him. His name was David Glenn. So I've been active for nearly a whole year. Of…
